**`src/interface/telegram/bot.py`** — کل فایل:


from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
import re
import time
from telegram.ext import (
    Application, CallbackQueryHandler,
    MessageHandler, filters,
)
from loguru import logger
from src.config import BOT_TOKEN, PLAYABLE_LETTERS, CATEGORIES, ROUND_DURATION
from src.domain.game_engine import GameEngine
from src.domain.word_repository import WordRepository
from src.domain.validator import Validator
from src.domain.scoring import ScoringEngine
from src.infrastructure.memory_state import InMemoryStateRepository
from src.application.game_service import GameService
from src.interface.telegram.dm_state import DMStateManager
from src.interface.telegram.handlers import group, dm
from src.interface.telegram import messages as msg
from src.interface.telegram import keyboards


GAME_TRIGGER = re.compile(
    r"^(بازی|شروع بازی|بازی اسم\s*و\s*فامیل|اسم\s*و\s*فامیل)$"
)


def create_application() -> Application:
    state_repo = InMemoryStateRepository()
    word_repo = WordRepository()
    word_repo.load_from_file("data/words.json")
    validator = Validator(PLAYABLE_LETTERS)
    scoring = ScoringEngine()
    engine = GameEngine(state_repo, word_repo, validator, scoring)
    service = GameService(engine)
    dm_state = DMStateManager()

    application = Application.builder().token(BOT_TOKEN).build()
    application.bot_data["service"] = service
    application.bot_data["dm_state"] = dm_state
    application.bot_data["game_messages"] = {}
    application.bot_data["pinned_messages"] = {}
    application.bot_data["round_starts"] = {}

    countdown_tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}

    async def update_game_status(game_id: str) -> None:
        game = await service.get_game(game_id)
        if not game or not game.current_round:
            return

        msg_store = application.bot_data.get("game_messages", {})
        stored_id = msg_store.get(game_id)
        if not stored_id:
            return

        start_t = application.bot_data.get("round_starts", {}).get(game_id, 0)
        elapsed = int(time.time() - start_t) if start_t else 0
        remaining = max(0, ROUND_DURATION - elapsed)

        rnd_num = game.current_round_index + 1
        prev_letter = None
        if rnd_num > 1 and len(game.rounds) > 1:
            prev_letter = game.rounds[rnd_num - 2].letter

        players_list = []
        for uid, player in game.players.items():
            done = dm_state.is_completed(game_id, uid)
            players_list.append((uid, player.display_name, done))

        text = msg.game_status_text(
            game.current_round.letter, rnd_num, game.total_rounds,
            remaining, players_list, prev_letter,
        )

        try:
            await application.bot.edit_message_text(
                chat_id=game.group_id, message_id=stored_id,
                text=text, parse_mode="HTML",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        for state in dm_state.get_states_for_game(game_id):
            if state.keyboard_message_id and not state.locked:
                try:
                    await application.bot.edit_message_text(
                        chat_id=state.user_id,
                        message_id=state.keyboard_message_id,
                        text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(
                            state.letter, state.answered_count,
                            len(CATEGORIES), remaining,
                        ),
                        reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard(
                            state.answers, state.locked,
                        ),
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass

    application.bot_data["update_game_status"] = update_game_status

    def start_countdown(game_id: str) -> None:
        old = countdown_tasks.pop(game_id, None)
        if old and not old.done():
            old.cancel()

        application.bot_data.setdefault("round_starts", {})[game_id] = time.time()

        async def _loop():
            while True:
                await asyncio.sleep(15)
                try:
                    await update_game_status(game_id)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        countdown_tasks[game_id] = asyncio.create_task(_loop())

    def cancel_countdown(game_id: str) -> None:
        task = countdown_tasks.pop(game_id, None)
        if task and not task.done():
            task.cancel()

    application.bot_data["start_countdown"] = start_countdown
    application.bot_data["cancel_countdown"] = cancel_countdown

    _setup_callbacks(service, application, dm_state, cancel_countdown)

    # ── گروه ──
    application.add_handler(
        MessageHandler(
            filters.ChatType.GROUPS & filters.TEXT & ~filters.COMMAND,
            group.handle_game_trigger,
        )
    )
    application.add_handler(
        MessageHandler(filters.ChatType.GROUPS & filters.COMMAND, group.leave_command),
        1,
    )
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(group.join_callback, pattern="^join_game$"))
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(group.start_callback, pattern="^start_game$"))
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(group.cancel_game_callback, pattern="^cancel_game$"))

    # ── پیوی ──
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(dm.handle_category_click, pattern="^cat:"))
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(dm.handle_finalize, pattern="^finalize$"))
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(dm.handle_noop, pattern="^noop$"))
    application.add_handler(
        MessageHandler(filters.ChatType.PRIVATE & filters.TEXT, dm.handle_dm_text)
    )

    return application


def _setup_callbacks(
    service: GameService,
    application: Application,
    dm_state: DMStateManager,
    cancel_countdown,
) -> None:
    async def on_round_end(game_id: str) -> None:
        cancel_countdown(game_id)

        game = await service.get_game(game_id)
        if not game:
            logger.warning(f"on_round_end: game {game_id} not found")
            return

        standings = [
            (p.display_name, p.score)
            for p in sorted(
                game.players.values(), key=lambda p: p.score, reverse=True
            )
        ]

        rnd_num = game.current_round_index + 1
        group_id = game.group_id
        msg_store = application.bot_data.get("game_messages", {})
        stored_id = msg_store.get(game_id)
        prev_letter = game.current_round.letter if game.current_round else None

        logger.info(f"Round {rnd_num} ended for game {game_id}")

        result_text = msg.round_results(rnd_num, game.total_rounds, standings)
        if stored_id:
            try:
                await application.bot.edit_message_text(
                    chat_id=group_id, message_id=stored_id, text=result_text,
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to edit results: {e}")

        if rnd_num < game.total_rounds:
            await asyncio.sleep(5)

            game2 = None
            rnd = None
            for attempt in range(3):
                try:
                    game2, rnd = await service.begin_round(game_id)
                    break
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"begin_round attempt {attempt + 1} failed: {e}")
                    if attempt < 2:
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

            if not game2 or not rnd:
                logger.error(f"All begin_round attempts failed for {game_id}")
                try:
                    await application.bot.send_message(
                        chat_id=group_id,
                        text="❌ خطا در شروع راند بعدی. بازی لغو شد.",
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
                await service.cleanup(game_id)
                return

            dm_state.reset_completed(game_id)

            players_list = [
                (uid, p.display_name, False)
                for uid, p in game2.players.items()
            ]
            rnd_num_new = game2.current_round_index + 1
            status_text = msg.game_status_text(
                rnd.letter, rnd_num_new, game2.total_rounds, 60,
                players_list, prev_letter,
            )

            try:
                sent = await application.bot.send_message(
                    chat_id=group_id, text=status_text, parse_mode="HTML",
                )
                msg_store[game_id] = sent.message_id
                stored_id = sent.message_id
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to send new round msg: {e}")
                return

            try:
                old_pinned = application.bot_data.get("pinned_messages", {}).get(game_id)
                if old_pinned:
                    await application.bot.unpin_chat_message(
                        chat_id=group_id, message_id=old_pinned,
                    )
            except Exception:
                pass

            try:
                await application.bot.pin_chat_message(
                    chat_id=group_id, message_id=stored_id,
                    disable_notification=True,
                )
                application.bot_data.setdefault("pinned_messages", {})[game_id] = stored_id
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to pin: {e}")

            start_cd = application.bot_data.get("start_countdown")
            if start_cd:
                start_cd(game_id)

            for pid in game2.players:
                try:
                    kb_msg = await application.bot.send_message(
                        chat_id=pid,
                        text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(rnd.letter, 0, len(CATEGORIES), 60),
                        reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard({}, False),
                    )
                    dm_state.start(pid, game_id, rnd.letter)
                    state = dm_state.get(pid)
                    if state:
                        state.keyboard_message_id = kb_msg.message_id
                except Exception:
                    pname = game2.players[pid].display_name
                    try:
                        await application.bot.send_message(
                            chat_id=group_id,
                            text=msg.dm_not_open_clickable(pid, pname),
                            parse_mode="HTML",
                        )
                    except Exception:
                        pass
        else:
            try:
                final = await service.finish_game(game_id)
                if stored_id:
                    try:
                        await application.bot.edit_message_text(
                            chat_id=group_id, message_id=stored_id,
                            text=msg.final_results(final),
                        )
                    except Exception:
                        await application.bot.send_message(
                            chat_id=group_id, text=msg.final_results(final),
                        )
                else:
                    await application.bot.send_message(
                        chat_id=group_id, text=msg.final_results(final),
                    )

                old_pinned = application.bot_data.get("pinned_messages", {}).pop(game_id, None)
                if old_pinned:
                    try:
                        await application.bot.unpin_chat_message(
                            chat_id=group_id, message_id=old_pinned,
                        )
                    except Exception:
                        pass

                dm_state.clear_for_game(game_id)
                msg_store.pop(game_id, None)
                application.bot_data.get("round_starts", {}).pop(game_id, None)
                logger.info(f"Game {game_id} finished and cleaned up")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to finish game: {e}")

    service.set_callbacks(on_round_end=on_round_end)

import html as html_mod
import asyncio
from telegram import Update
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes
from loguru import logger
from src.interface.telegram import messages as msg
from src.interface.telegram import keyboards


async def handle_game_trigger(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    if not update.effective_chat or not update.effective_user or not update.message:
        return

    text = update.message.text
    if not text:
        return
    text = text.strip()

    triggers = ["بازی", "شروع بازی", "بازی اسم و فامیل", "اسم و فامیل"]
    if text not in triggers:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    group_id = update.effective_chat.id
    user = update.effective_user

    existing = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if existing:
        await update.message.reply_text(msg.error("یه بازی فعال هست."))
        return

    game = await service.create_game(group_id, user.id)
    name = user.full_name or user.first_name or str(user.id)
    await service.join_game(game.game_id, user.id, user.username or "", name)

    game = await service.get_game(game.game_id)
    players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}

    await update.message.reply_text(
        msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
        reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
        parse_mode="HTML",
    )


async def join_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        return

    name = user.full_name or user.first_name or str(user.id)
    try:
        game = await service.join_game(game.game_id, user.id, user.username or "", name)
    except ValueError as e:
        await query.answer(str(e), show_alert=True)
        return

    dm_ok = True
    try:
        await context.bot.send_message(
            chat_id=user.id,
            text="✅ ثبت‌نام شد! منتظر شروع بازی باش.",
        )
    except Exception:
        dm_ok = False

    players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}
    try:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
            reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
            parse_mode="HTML",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    if dm_ok:
        await query.answer(f"خوش اومدی {name}! ✨")
    else:
        await query.answer(
            f"{name}، لطفاً اول ربات رو توی پیوی استارت کن!", show_alert=True,
        )


async def start_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        return

    if user.id != game.host_id:
        await query.answer("فقط میزبان!", show_alert=True)
        return

    try:
        game = await service.start_game(game.game_id, user.id)
    except ValueError as e:
        await query.answer(str(e), show_alert=True)
        return

    game2, rnd = await service.begin_round(game.game_id)

    context.bot_data.setdefault("game_messages", {})[game.game_id] = query.message.message_id

    try:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            msg.game_started(rnd.letter, 1, game2.total_rounds),
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        await context.bot.pin_chat_message(
            chat_id=group_id, message_id=query.message.message_id,
            disable_notification=True,
        )
        context.bot_data.setdefault("pinned_messages", {})[game.game_id] = query.message.message_id
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to pin: {e}")

    start_cd = context.bot_data.get("start_countdown")
    if start_cd:
        start_cd(game.game_id)

    dm_failed = []
    for pid in game2.players:
        try:
            kb_msg = await context.bot.send_message(
                chat_id=pid,
                text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(rnd.letter, 0, len(CATEGORIES), 60),
                reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard({}, False),
            )
            dm_state.start(pid, game.game_id, rnd.letter)
            state = dm_state.get(pid)
            if state:
                state.keyboard_message_id = kb_msg.message_id
        except Exception:
            dm_failed.append((pid, game2.players[pid].display_name))

    if dm_failed:
        names = "، ".join(
            f'<a href="tg://user?id={uid}">{html_mod.escape(n)}</a>'
            for uid, n in dm_failed
        )
        try:
            await context.bot.send_message(
                chat_id=group_id,
                text=f"⚠️ {names} پیوی بات رو باز نکردن!",
                parse_mode="HTML",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    await query.answer("بازی شروع شد! 🎮")


async def leave_command(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    if not update.effective_chat or not update.effective_user or not update.message:
        return

    text = update.message.text
    if not text or text.strip() != "/leave":
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    group_id = update.effective_chat.id
    user_id = update.effective_user.id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        return

    if user_id == game.host_id:
        await update.message.reply_text(msg.error("میزبان نمی‌تونه خارج بشه."))
        return

    try:
        await service.leave_game(game.game_id, user_id)
    except ValueError:
        return

    game = await service.get_game(game.game_id)
    if game:
        players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}
        await update.message.reply_text(
            msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
            reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
            parse_mode="HTML",
        )


async def cancel_game_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game:
        await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        return

    if user.id != game.host_id:
        await query.answer("فقط میزبان می‌تونه لغو کنه!", show_alert=True)
        return

    cancel_cd = context.bot_data.get("cancel_countdown")
    if cancel_cd:
        cancel_cd(game.game_id)

    pinned = context.bot_data.get("pinned_messages", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)
    if pinned:
        try:
            await context.bot.unpin_chat_message(
                chat_id=group_id, message_id=pinned,
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    dm_state.clear_for_game(game.game_id)
    await service.cleanup(game.game_id)
    context.bot_data.get("game_messages", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)
    context.bot_data.get("round_starts", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)

    try:
        await query.edit_message_text("🚫 بازی لغو شد.")
    except Exception:
        pass

    await query.answer("بازی لغو شد!")

**`src/interface/telegram/handlers/dm.py`** — کل فایل:


import asyncio
from telegram import Update, ForceReply
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes
from loguru import logger
from src.config import CATEGORIES
from src.interface.telegram import messages as msg
from src.interface.telegram import keyboards


async def handle_category_click(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.message or query.message.chat.type != "private":
        return

    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user_id = query.from_user.id

    cat_code = query.data.split(":")[1]
    category = keyboards.CALLBACK_TO_CAT.get(cat_code)
    if not category:
        try:
            await query.answer()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        try:
            await query.answer("راند تموم شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    if state.locked:
        try:
            await query.answer("جوابات قفل شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state.pending_category = category
    try:
        await context.bot.send_message(
            chat_id=user_id,
            text=f"📝 یه {category} با حرف «{state.letter}» بنویس:",
            reply_markup=ForceReply(selective=True),
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to send ForceReply: {e}")

    try:
        await query.answer()
    except Exception:
        pass


async def handle_finalize(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.message or query.message.chat.type != "private":
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    update_status = context.bot_data.get("update_game_status")
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    display_name = query.from_user.full_name or query.from_user.first_name or str(user_id)

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        try:
            await query.answer("راند تموم شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state.lock()
    game = await service.get_game(state.game_id)
    game_id = state.game_id
    dm_state.clear(user_id)

    if state.keyboard_message_id:
        try:
            await context.bot.edit_message_text(
                chat_id=user_id,
                message_id=state.keyboard_message_id,
                text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(state.letter, 0, 0, 60),
                reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard(state.answers, True),
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        await query.answer("قفل شد! 🔒")
    except Exception:
        pass

    await context.bot.send_message(chat_id=user_id, text=msg.dm_locked())

    if update_status and game:
        try:
            await update_status(game_id)
        except Exception:
            pass


async def handle_noop(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if query:
        try:
            await query.answer("جوابات قفل شده! 🔒", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass


async def handle_dm_text(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    update_status = context.bot_data.get("update_game_status")

    if not update.message or not update.effective_user:
        return

    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    text = update.message.text
    if not text:
        return
    text = text.strip()

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        return

    async with dm_state.get_lock(user_id):
        state = dm_state.get(user_id)
        if not state:
            return

        if state.locked:
            await update.message.reply_text("🔒 جوابات قفل شده!")
            return

        if not state.pending_category:
            await update.message.reply_text(
                "💡 اول یه دسته رو از روی دکمه‌ها انتخاب کن!"
            )
            return

        category = state.pending_category
        state.pending_category = None

        try:
            answer = await service.submit_answer(
                state.game_id, user_id, category, text,
            )
        except ValueError:
            return

        state.answers[category] = text.strip()

        if state.keyboard_message_id:
            game = await service.get_game(state.game_id)
            remaining = _calc_remaining(context)
            try:
                await context.bot.edit_message_text(
                    chat_id=user_id,
                    message_id=state.keyboard_message_id,
                    text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(
                        state.letter, state.answered_count,
                        state.total_categories, remaining,
                    ),
                    reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard(
                        state.answers, state.locked,
                    ),
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to edit keyboard: {e}")

        await update.message.reply_text(
            msg.dm_answer_saved(category, text, answer.is_valid)
        )

        if update_status:
            try:
                await update_status(state.game_id)
            except Exception:
                pass


def _calc_remaining(context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE) -> int:
    import time
    from src.config import ROUND_DURATION
    start_t = context.bot_data.get("round_starts", {})
    for gid, t in start_t.items():
        if t > 0:
            elapsed = int(time.time() - t)
            return max(0, ROUND_DURATION - elapsed)
    return ROUND_DURATION

import html as html_mod
import asyncio
from telegram import Update
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes
from loguru import logger
from src.interface.telegram import messages as msg
from src.interface.telegram import keyboards


async def handle_game_trigger(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    if not update.effective_chat or not update.effective_user or not update.message:
        return

    text = update.message.text
    if not text:
        return
    text = text.strip()

    triggers = ["بازی", "شروع بازی", "بازی اسم و فامیل", "اسم و فامیل"]
    if text not in triggers:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    group_id = update.effective_chat.id
    user = update.effective_user

    existing = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if existing:
        await update.message.reply_text(msg.error("یه بازی فعال هست."))
        return

    game = await service.create_game(group_id, user.id)
    name = user.full_name or user.first_name or str(user.id)
    await service.join_game(game.game_id, user.id, user.username or "", name)

    game = await service.get_game(game.game_id)
    players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}

    await update.message.reply_text(
        msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
        reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
        parse_mode="HTML",
    )


async def join_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        try:
            await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    name = user.full_name or user.first_name or str(user.id)
    try:
        game = await service.join_game(game.game_id, user.id, user.username or "", name)
    except ValueError as e:
        try:
            await query.answer(str(e), show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    dm_ok = True
    try:
        await context.bot.send_message(
            chat_id=user.id,
            text="✅ ثبت‌نام شد! منتظر شروع بازی باش.",
        )
    except Exception:
        dm_ok = False

    players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}
    try:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
            reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
            parse_mode="HTML",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        if dm_ok:
            await query.answer(f"خوش اومدی {name}! ✨")
        else:
            await query.answer(
                f"{name}، لطفاً اول ربات رو توی پیوی استارت کن!", show_alert=True,
            )
    except Exception:
        pass


async def start_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        try:
            await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    if user.id != game.host_id:
        try:
            await query.answer("فقط میزبان!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    try:
        game = await service.start_game(game.game_id, user.id)
    except ValueError as e:
        try:
            await query.answer(str(e), show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    game2, rnd = await service.begin_round(game.game_id)

    context.bot_data.setdefault("game_messages", {})[game.game_id] = query.message.message_id

    try:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            msg.game_started(rnd.letter, 1, game2.total_rounds),
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        await context.bot.pin_chat_message(
            chat_id=group_id, message_id=query.message.message_id,
            disable_notification=True,
        )
        context.bot_data.setdefault("pinned_messages", {})[game.game_id] = query.message.message_id
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to pin: {e}")

    start_cd = context.bot_data.get("start_countdown")
    if start_cd:
        start_cd(game.game_id)

    dm_failed = []
    for pid in game2.players:
        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        try:
            kb_msg = await context.bot.send_message(
                chat_id=pid,
                text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(rnd.letter, 0, len(CATEGORIES), 60),
                reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard({}, False),
            )
            dm_state.start(pid, game.game_id, rnd.letter)
            state = dm_state.get(pid)
            if state:
                state.keyboard_message_id = kb_msg.message_id
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"DM failed for {pid}: {e}")
            dm_failed.append((pid, game2.players[pid].display_name))

    if dm_failed:
        names = "، ".join(
            f'<a href="tg://user?id={uid}">{html_mod.escape(n)}</a>'
            for uid, n in dm_failed
        )
        try:
            await context.bot.send_message(
                chat_id=group_id,
                text=f"⚠️ {names} پیوی بات رو باز نکردن!",
                parse_mode="HTML",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        await query.answer("بازی شروع شد! 🎮")
    except Exception:
        pass


async def leave_command(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    if not update.effective_chat or not update.effective_user or not update.message:
        return

    text = update.message.text
    if not text or text.strip() != "/leave":
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    group_id = update.effective_chat.id
    user_id = update.effective_user.id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        return

    if user_id == game.host_id:
        await update.message.reply_text(msg.error("میزبان نمی‌تونه خارج بشه."))
        return

    try:
        await service.leave_game(game.game_id, user_id)
    except ValueError:
        return

    game = await service.get_game(game.game_id)
    if game:
        players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}
        await update.message.reply_text(
            msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
            reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
            parse_mode="HTML",
        )


async def cancel_game_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game:
        try:
            await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    if user.id != game.host_id:
        try:
            await query.answer("فقط میزبان می‌تونه لغو کنه!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    cancel_cd = context.bot_data.get("cancel_countdown")
    if cancel_cd:
        cancel_cd(game.game_id)

    pinned = context.bot_data.get("pinned_messages", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)
    if pinned:
        try:
            await context.bot.unpin_chat_message(
                chat_id=group_id, message_id=pinned,
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    dm_state.clear_for_game(game.game_id)
    await service.cleanup(game.game_id)
    context.bot_data.get("game_messages", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)
    context.bot_data.get("round_starts", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)

    try:
        await query.edit_message_text("🚫 بازی لغو شد.")
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        await query.answer("بازی لغو شد!")
    except Exception:
        pass

from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
import time
from telegram.ext import (
    Application, CallbackQueryHandler,
    MessageHandler, filters,
)
from loguru import logger
from src.config import BOT_TOKEN, PLAYABLE_LETTERS, CATEGORIES, ROUND_DURATION
from src.domain.game_engine import GameEngine
from src.domain.word_repository import WordRepository
from src.domain.validator import Validator
from src.domain.scoring import ScoringEngine
from src.infrastructure.memory_state import InMemoryStateRepository
from src.application.game_service import GameService
from src.interface.telegram.dm_state import DMStateManager
from src.interface.telegram.handlers import group, dm
from src.interface.telegram import messages as msg
from src.interface.telegram import keyboards


def create_application() -> Application:
    state_repo = InMemoryStateRepository()
    word_repo = WordRepository()
    word_repo.load_from_file("data/words.json")
    validator = Validator(PLAYABLE_LETTERS)
    scoring = ScoringEngine()
    engine = GameEngine(state_repo, word_repo, validator, scoring)
    service = GameService(engine)
    dm_state = DMStateManager()

    application = Application.builder().token(BOT_TOKEN).build()
    application.bot_data["service"] = service
    application.bot_data["dm_state"] = dm_state
    application.bot_data["game_messages"] = {}
    application.bot_data["pinned_messages"] = {}
    application.bot_data["round_starts"] = {}

    countdown_tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}

    async def update_game_status(game_id: str) -> None:
        game = await service.get_game(game_id)
        if not game or not game.current_round:
            return

        msg_store = application.bot_data.get("game_messages", {})
        stored_id = msg_store.get(game_id)
        if not stored_id:
            return

        start_t = application.bot_data.get("round_starts", {}).get(game_id, 0)
        elapsed = int(time.time() - start_t) if start_t else 0
        remaining = max(0, ROUND_DURATION - elapsed)

        rnd_num = game.current_round_index + 1
        prev_letter = None
        if rnd_num > 1 and len(game.rounds) > 1:
            prev_letter = game.rounds[rnd_num - 2].letter

        players_list = []
        for uid, player in game.players.items():
            done = dm_state.is_completed(game_id, uid)
            players_list.append((uid, player.display_name, done))

        text = msg.game_status_text(
            game.current_round.letter, rnd_num, game.total_rounds,
            remaining, players_list, prev_letter,
        )

        try:
            await application.bot.edit_message_text(
                chat_id=game.group_id, message_id=stored_id,
                text=text, parse_mode="HTML",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        for state in dm_state.get_states_for_game(game_id):
            if state.keyboard_message_id and not state.locked:
                try:
                    await application.bot.edit_message_text(
                        chat_id=state.user_id,
                        message_id=state.keyboard_message_id,
                        text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(
                            state.letter, state.answered_count,
                            len(CATEGORIES), remaining,
                        ),
                        reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard(
                            state.answers, state.locked,
                        ),
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass

    application.bot_data["update_game_status"] = update_game_status

    def start_countdown(game_id: str) -> None:
        old = countdown_tasks.pop(game_id, None)
        if old and not old.done():
            old.cancel()

        application.bot_data.setdefault("round_starts", {})[game_id] = time.time()

        async def _loop():
            while True:
                await asyncio.sleep(15)
                try:
                    await update_game_status(game_id)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        countdown_tasks[game_id] = asyncio.create_task(_loop())

    def cancel_countdown(game_id: str) -> None:
        task = countdown_tasks.pop(game_id, None)
        if task and not task.done():
            task.cancel()

    application.bot_data["start_countdown"] = start_countdown
    application.bot_data["cancel_countdown"] = cancel_countdown

    _setup_callbacks(service, application, dm_state, cancel_countdown)

    # ── گروه ──
    application.add_handler(
        MessageHandler(
            filters.ChatType.GROUPS & filters.TEXT & ~filters.COMMAND,
            group.handle_game_trigger,
        )
    )
    application.add_handler(
        MessageHandler(filters.ChatType.GROUPS & filters.COMMAND, group.leave_command),
        1,
    )
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(group.join_callback, pattern="^join_game$"))
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(group.start_callback, pattern="^start_game$"))
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(group.cancel_game_callback, pattern="^cancel_game$"))

    # ── پیوی ──
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(dm.handle_category_click, pattern="^cat:"))
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(dm.handle_finalize, pattern="^finalize$"))
    application.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(dm.handle_noop, pattern="^noop$"))
    application.add_handler(
        MessageHandler(filters.ChatType.PRIVATE & filters.TEXT, dm.handle_dm_text)
    )

    # ── error handler ──
    application.add_error_handler(_error_handler)

    return application


async def _error_handler(update: object, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE) -> None:
    logger.error(f"Exception while handling update: {context.error}")


def _setup_callbacks(
    service: GameService,
    application: Application,
    dm_state: DMStateManager,
    cancel_countdown,
) -> None:
    async def on_round_end(game_id: str) -> None:
        cancel_countdown(game_id)

        game = await service.get_game(game_id)
        if not game:
            logger.warning(f"on_round_end: game {game_id} not found")
            return

        standings = [
            (p.display_name, p.score)
            for p in sorted(
                game.players.values(), key=lambda p: p.score, reverse=True
            )
        ]

        rnd_num = game.current_round_index + 1
        group_id = game.group_id
        msg_store = application.bot_data.get("game_messages", {})
        stored_id = msg_store.get(game_id)
        prev_letter = game.current_round.letter if game.current_round else None

        logger.info(f"Round {rnd_num} ended for game {game_id}")

        result_text = msg.round_results(rnd_num, game.total_rounds, standings)
        if stored_id:
            try:
                await application.bot.edit_message_text(
                    chat_id=group_id, message_id=stored_id, text=result_text,
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to edit results: {e}")

        if rnd_num < game.total_rounds:
            await asyncio.sleep(5)

            game2 = None
            rnd = None
            for attempt in range(3):
                try:
                    game2, rnd = await service.begin_round(game_id)
                    break
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"begin_round attempt {attempt + 1} failed: {e}")
                    if attempt < 2:
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

            if not game2 or not rnd:
                logger.error(f"All begin_round attempts failed for {game_id}")
                try:
                    await application.bot.send_message(
                        chat_id=group_id,
                        text="❌ خطا در شروع راند بعدی. بازی لغو شد.",
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
                await service.cleanup(game_id)
                return

            dm_state.reset_completed(game_id)

            rnd_num_new = game2.current_round_index + 1
            players_list = [
                (uid, p.display_name, False)
                for uid, p in game2.players.items()
            ]
            status_text = msg.game_status_text(
                rnd.letter, rnd_num_new, game2.total_rounds, 60,
                players_list, prev_letter,
            )

            try:
                sent = await application.bot.send_message(
                    chat_id=group_id, text=status_text, parse_mode="HTML",
                )
                msg_store[game_id] = sent.message_id
                stored_id = sent.message_id
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to send new round msg: {e}")
                return

            try:
                old_pinned = application.bot_data.get("pinned_messages", {}).get(game_id)
                if old_pinned:
                    await application.bot.unpin_chat_message(
                        chat_id=group_id, message_id=old_pinned,
                    )
            except Exception:
                pass

            try:
                await application.bot.pin_chat_message(
                    chat_id=group_id, message_id=stored_id,
                    disable_notification=True,
                )
                application.bot_data.setdefault("pinned_messages", {})[game_id] = stored_id
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to pin: {e}")

            start_cd = application.bot_data.get("start_countdown")
            if start_cd:
                start_cd(game_id)

            for pid in game2.players:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                try:
                    kb_msg = await application.bot.send_message(
                        chat_id=pid,
                        text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(rnd.letter, 0, len(CATEGORIES), 60),
                        reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard({}, False),
                    )
                    dm_state.start(pid, game_id, rnd.letter)
                    state = dm_state.get(pid)
                    if state:
                        state.keyboard_message_id = kb_msg.message_id
                except Exception:
                    pname = game2.players[pid].display_name
                    try:
                        await application.bot.send_message(
                            chat_id=group_id,
                            text=msg.dm_not_open_clickable(pid, pname),
                            parse_mode="HTML",
                        )
                    except Exception:
                        pass
        else:
            try:
                final = await service.finish_game(game_id)
                if stored_id:
                    try:
                        await application.bot.edit_message_text(
                            chat_id=group_id, message_id=stored_id,
                            text=msg.final_results(final),
                        )
                    except Exception:
                        await application.bot.send_message(
                            chat_id=group_id, text=msg.final_results(final),
                        )
                else:
                    await application.bot.send_message(
                        chat_id=group_id, text=msg.final_results(final),
                    )

                old_pinned = application.bot_data.get("pinned_messages", {}).pop(game_id, None)
                if old_pinned:
                    try:
                        await application.bot.unpin_chat_message(
                            chat_id=group_id, message_id=old_pinned,
                        )
                    except Exception:
                        pass

                dm_state.clear_for_game(game_id)
                msg_store.pop(game_id, None)
                application.bot_data.get("round_starts", {}).pop(game_id, None)
                logger.info(f"Game {game_id} finished and cleaned up")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to finish game: {e}")

    service.set_callbacks(on_round_end=on_round_end)

import asyncio
from telegram import Update
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes
from loguru import logger
from src.config import CATEGORIES
from src.interface.telegram import messages as msg
from src.interface.telegram import keyboards


async def handle_category_click(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.message or query.message.chat.type != "private":
        return

    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user_id = query.from_user.id

    cat_code = query.data.split(":")[1]
    category = keyboards.CALLBACK_TO_CAT.get(cat_code)
    if not category:
        try:
            await query.answer()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        try:
            await query.answer("راند تموم شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    if state.locked:
        try:
            await query.answer("جوابات قفل شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state.pending_category = category
    prompt = await context.bot.send_message(
        chat_id=user_id,
        text=f"📝 یه {category} با حرف «{state.letter}» بنویس:",
    )

    state.pending_prompt_id = prompt.message_id

    try:
        await query.answer()
    except Exception:
        pass

    asyncio.create_task(_delete_later(context, user_id, prompt.message_id, 30))


async def _delete_later(context, chat_id, msg_id, seconds):
    await asyncio.sleep(seconds)
    try:
        await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=chat_id, message_id=msg_id)
    except Exception:
        pass


async def handle_finalize(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.message or query.message.chat.type != "private":
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    update_status = context.bot_data.get("update_game_status")
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    display_name = query.from_user.full_name or query.from_user.first_name or str(user_id)

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        try:
            await query.answer("راند تموم شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state.lock()
    game = await service.get_game(state.game_id)
    game_id = state.game_id
    dm_state.clear(user_id)

    if state.keyboard_message_id:
        try:
            await context.bot.edit_message_text(
                chat_id=user_id,
                message_id=state.keyboard_message_id,
                text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(state.letter, 0, 0, 60),
                reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard(state.answers, True),
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        await query.answer("قفل شد! 🔒")
    except Exception:
        pass

    await context.bot.send_message(chat_id=user_id, text=msg.dm_locked())

    if update_status and game:
        try:
            await update_status(game_id)
        except Exception:
            pass


async def handle_noop(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if query:
        try:
            await query.answer("جوابات قفل شده! 🔒", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass


async def handle_dm_text(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    update_status = context.bot_data.get("update_game_status")

    if not update.message or not update.effective_user:
        return

    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    text = update.message.text
    if not text:
        return
    text = text.strip()
    user_msg_id = update.message.message_id

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        return

    async with dm_state.get_lock(user_id):
        state = dm_state.get(user_id)
        if not state:
            return

        if state.locked:
            try:
                await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=user_id, message_id=user_msg_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        if not state.pending_category:
            try:
                await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=user_id, message_id=user_msg_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        category = state.pending_category
        state.pending_category = None

        # پاک کردن پیام توضیح
        prompt_id = getattr(state, 'pending_prompt_id', None)
        if prompt_id:
            try:
                await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=user_id, message_id=prompt_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

        # پاک کردن پیام کاربر
        try:
            await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=user_id, message_id=user_msg_id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            answer = await service.submit_answer(
                state.game_id, user_id, category, text,
            )
        except ValueError:
            return

        state.answers[category] = text.strip()

        # ادیت کیبورد با جواب جدید
        game = await service.get_game(state.game_id)
        remaining = _calc_remaining(context)
        if state.keyboard_message_id:
            try:
                await context.bot.edit_message_text(
                    chat_id=user_id,
                    message_id=state.keyboard_message_id,
                    text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(
                        state.letter, state.answered_count,
                        state.total_categories, remaining,
                    ),
                    reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard(
                        state.answers, state.locked,
                    ),
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to edit keyboard: {e}")

        # ارسال تأیید کوتاه + پاک شدن خودکار
        confirm = await context.bot.send_message(
            chat_id=user_id,
            text=msg.dm_answer_saved(category, text, answer.is_valid),
        )
        asyncio.create_task(_delete_later(context, user_id, confirm.message_id, 5))

        if update_status:
            try:
                await update_status(state.game_id)
            except Exception:
                pass


def _calc_remaining(context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE) -> int:
    import time
    from src.config import ROUND_DURATION
    start_t = context.bot_data.get("round_starts", {})
    for gid, t in start_t.items():
        if t > 0:
            elapsed = int(time.time() - t)
            return max(0, ROUND_DURATION - elapsed)
    return ROUND_DURATION

**`src/interface/telegram/dm_state.py`** — `DMState` کلاس رو اصلاح کن (یه فیلد اضافه شده):


from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from src.config import CATEGORIES


@dataclass
class DMState:
    user_id: int
    game_id: str
    letter: str
    category_index: int = 0
    answers: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    pending_category: str | None = None
    pending_prompt_id: int | None = None
    locked: bool = False
    keyboard_message_id: int | None = None

    @property
    def current_category(self) -> str:
        return CATEGORIES[self.category_index]

    @property
    def answered_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.answers)

    @property
    def total_categories(self) -> int:
        return len(CATEGORIES)

    def advance(self) -> bool:
        for i in range(len(CATEGORIES)):
            if CATEGORIES[i] not in self.answers:
                self.category_index = i
                return True
        return False

    def lock(self) -> None:
        self.locked = True


class DMStateManager:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._states: dict[int, DMState] = {}
        self._locks: dict[int, asyncio.Lock] = {}
        self._completed: dict[str, set[int]] = {}

    def start(self, user_id: int, game_id: str, letter: str) -> None:
        self._states[user_id] = DMState(
            user_id=user_id, game_id=game_id, letter=letter,
        )

    def get(self, user_id: int) -> DMState | None:
        return self._states.get(user_id)

    def get_states_for_game(self, game_id: str) -> list[DMState]:
        return [s for s in self._states.values() if s.game_id == game_id]

    def clear(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        state = self._states.pop(user_id, None)
        if state:
            self._completed.setdefault(state.game_id, set()).add(user_id)

    def clear_for_game(self, game_id: str) -> None:
        keys = [uid for uid, s in self._states.items() if s.game_id == game_id]
        for uid in keys:
            self._states.pop(uid)
        self._completed.pop(game_id, None)

    def completed_count(self, game_id: str) -> int:
        return len(self._completed.get(game_id, set()))

    def reset_completed(self, game_id: str) -> None:
        self._completed.pop(game_id, None)

    def is_completed(self, game_id: str, user_id: int) -> bool:
        return user_id in self._completed.get(game_id, set())

    def get_lock(self, user_id: int) -> asyncio.Lock:
        if user_id not in self._locks:
            self._locks[user_id] = asyncio.Lock()
        return self._locks[user_id]

    def answered_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.answers)

    @property
    def total_categories(self) -> int:
        return len(CATEGORIES)

    def advance(self) -> bool:
        for i in range(len(CATEGORIES)):
            if CATEGORIES[i] not in self.answers:
                self.category_index = i
                return True
        return False

    def lock(self) -> None:
        self.locked = True


class DMStateManager:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._states: dict[int, DMState] = {}
        self._locks: dict[int, asyncio.Lock] = {}
        self._completed: dict[str, set[int]] = {}

    def start(self, user_id: int, game_id: str, letter: str) -> None:
        self._states[user_id] = DMState(
            user_id=user_id, game_id=game_id, letter=letter,
        )

    def get(self, user_id: int) -> DMState | None:
        return self._states.get(user_id)

    def get_states_for_game(self, game_id: str) -> list[DMState]:
        return [s for s in self._states.values() if s.game_id == game_id]

    def clear(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        state = self._states.pop(user_id, None)
        if state:
            self._completed.setdefault(state.game_id, set()).add(user_id)

    def clear_for_game(self, game_id: str) -> None:
        keys = [uid for uid, s in self._states.items() if s.game_id == game_id]
        for uid in keys:
            self._states.pop(uid)
        self._completed.pop(game_id, None)

    def completed_count(self, game_id: str) -> int:
        return len(self._completed.get(game_id, set()))

    def reset_completed(self, game_id: str) -> None:
        self._completed.pop(game_id, None)

    def is_completed(self, game_id: str, user_id: int) -> bool:
        return user_id in self._completed.get(game_id, set())

    def get_lock(self, user_id: int) -> asyncio.Lock:
        if user_id not in self._locks:
            self._locks[user_id] = asyncio.Lock()
        return self._locks[user_id]

from telegram import InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup
from src.config import CATEGORIES


CAT_CALLBACKS = {
    "اسم": "c1", "فامیل": "c2", "شهر": "c3",
    "کشور": "c4", "حیوان": "c5",
}
CALLBACK_TO_CAT = {v: k for k, v in CAT_CALLBACKS.items()}
CAT_ICONS = {
    "اسم": "👤", "فامیل": "👨‍👩‍👧", "شهر": "🏙️",
    "کشور": "🌍", "حیوان": "🐾",
}


def category_keyboard(answers: dict[str, str], locked: bool) -> InlineKeyboardMarkup:
    row1 = []
    for c in CATEGORIES:
        answer = answers.get(c)
        icon = CAT_ICONS.get(c, "📝")
        label = f"{icon}{c}:{answer}" if answer else f"{icon}{c}:---"
        row1.append(InlineKeyboardButton(label, callback_data=f"cat:{CAT_CALLBACKS[c]}"))

    if locked:
        row2 = [InlineKeyboardButton("🔒 ثبت شد ✓", callback_data="noop")]
    else:
        row2 = [InlineKeyboardButton("🔒 ثبت نهایی", callback_data="finalize")]
    return InlineKeyboardMarkup([row1, row2])


def lobby_keyboard() -> InlineKeyboardMarkup:
    return InlineKeyboardMarkup([
        [InlineKeyboardButton("✋ شرکت در بازی", callback_data="join_game")],
        [
            InlineKeyboardButton("🚀 شروع بازی", callback_data="start_game"),
            InlineKeyboardButton("🚫 لغو بازی", callback_data="cancel_game"),
        ],
    ])

import html as html_mod
from src.config import CATEGORIES


CATEGORY_ICONS = {
    "اسم": "👤", "فامیل": "👨‍👩‍👧", "شهر": "🏙️",
    "کشور": "🌍", "حیوان": "🐾",
}


def progress_bar(answered: int, total: int) -> str:
    filled = "✅" * answered
    empty = "⬜" * (total - answered)
    return f"{filled}{empty} {answered}/{total}"


def lobby(count: int, players: dict[int, str]) -> str:
    if not players:
        return (
            "🎮 بازی اسم‌وفامیل\n"
            "═════════════════════\n\n"
            "📋 بازیکنان (۰ نفر)\n"
            "منتظر بازیکن..."
        )
    lines = []
    for i, (uid, name) in enumerate(players.items(), 1):
        safe = html_mod.escape(name)
        lines.append(f'  {i}. <a href="tg://user?id={uid}">{safe}</a>')
    list_ = "\n".join(lines)
    return (
        "🎮 بازی اسم‌وفامیل\n"
        "═════════════════════\n\n"
        f"📋 بازیکنان ({count} نفر):\n{list_}\n\n"
        "🎯 حداقل ۲ بازیکن برای شروع"
    )


def game_started(letter: str, num: int, total: int) -> str:
    return (
        "═════════════════════\n"
        "  🎮 بازی شروع شد!\n\n"
        f"  ⏳ راند {num} از {total}\n"
        f"  حرف «{letter}» اعلام شد!\n"
        "═════════════════════\n\n"
        "  ✉️ جواب‌ها رو از پیوی بات بفرستید\n"
    )


def game_status_text(
    letter: str, num: int, total: int, remaining: int,
    players: list[tuple[int, str, bool]],
    prev_letter: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    timer = f"⏱️ {remaining} ثانیه مونده" if remaining > 0 else "⏱️ زمان تموم شد!"
    prev = f"\n  📊 راند قبلی: حرف «{prev_letter}»" if prev_letter else ""
    lines = [
        "═════════════════════",
        f"  🎮 راند {num} از {total}",
        f"  حرف «{letter}»",
        "═════════════════════\n",
        f"  {timer}{prev}\n",
        "📋 وضعیت بازیکنان:\n",
    ]
    for uid, name, done in players:
        safe = html_mod.escape(name)
        icon = "✅" if done else "⏳"
        status = "ثبت شد ✓" if done else "منتظر..."
        lines.append(f'  {icon} <a href="tg://user?id={uid}">{safe}</a> — {status}')
    lines.append("\n═════════════════════")
    lines.append("✉️ جواب‌ها رو از پیوی بات بفرستید")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def round_results(num: int, total: int, standings: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> str:
    lines = [
        "═════════════════════",
        f"📊 نتایج راند {num} از {total}:\n",
    ]
    for i, (name, score) in enumerate(standings, 1):
        medal = ["🥇", "🥈", "🥉"][i - 1] if i <= 3 else f"  {i}."
        lines.append(f"  {medal} {name}: {score}")
    lines.append("\n⏳ راند بعدی شروع می‌شه...")
    lines.append("═════════════════════")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def final_results(standings: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> str:
    medals = ["🥇", "🥈", "🥉"]
    lines = [
        "🏆 ═════════════════════",
        "      نتایج نهایی",
        "═════════════════════\n",
    ]
    for i, (name, score) in enumerate(standings):
        m = medals[i] if i < 3 else f"  {i+1}."
        lines.append(f"  {m} {name}: {score} امتیاز")
    lines.append("\n═════════════════════")
    lines.append("🎮 برای بازی جدید بنویس «بازی»")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def dm_keyboard_text(letter: str, answered: int, total: int, remaining: int) -> str:
    progress = progress_bar(answered, total)
    timer = f"⏱️ {remaining} ثانیه مونده" if remaining > 0 else "⏱️ زمان تموم شد!"
    return (
        f"<b>🎮 راند — حرف «{letter}»</b>\n\n"
        f"{timer}\n\n"
        f"پیشرفت: {progress}\n\n"
        "یه دسته رو انتخاب کن:"
    )


def dm_answer_saved(cat: str, text: str, is_valid: bool) -> str:
    if is_valid:
        return f"✅ {cat}: «{text}» ثبت شد"
    return f"❌ {cat}: «{text}» جواب نامعتبر"


def dm_locked() -> str:
    return "🔒 جوابات قفل شد!\nمنتظر نتایج باش."


def dm_done() -> str:
    return (
        "═════════════════════\n"
        "🎉 تموم شد!\n"
        "جوابات ثبت شد.\n"
        "منتظر نتایج باش!\n"
        "═════════════════════"
    )


def player_completed(name: str, done: int, total: int) -> str:
    return f"✅ {name} جواب‌ها رو ثبت کرد! ({done}/{total} نفر)"


def dm_not_open_clickable(user_id: int, name: str) -> str:
    safe = html_mod.escape(name)
    return (
        f'⚠️ <a href="tg://user?id={user_id}">{safe}</a> '
        "چت خصوصی بات رو باز نکرده!\n"
        "لطفاً اول ربات رو استارت کنید."
    )


def dm_inactive() -> str:
    return (
        "⚠️ الان فعالیتی نیست.\n"
        "اگه توی گروه بازی هستی، منتظر پیام بات باش."
    )


def error(text: str) -> str:
    return f"⚠️ {text}"

import asyncio
from telegram import Update
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes
from loguru import logger
from src.config import CATEGORIES
from src.interface.telegram import messages as msg
from src.interface.telegram import keyboards


async def handle_category_click(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.message or query.message.chat.type != "private":
        return

    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user_id = query.from_user.id

    cat_code = query.data.split(":")[1]
    category = keyboards.CALLBACK_TO_CAT.get(cat_code)
    if not category:
        try:
            await query.answer()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        try:
            await query.answer("راند تموم شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    if state.locked:
        try:
            await query.answer("جوابات قفل شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state.pending_category = category
    prompt = await context.bot.send_message(
        chat_id=user_id,
        text=f"📝 یه {category} با حرف «{state.letter}» بنویس:",
    )
    state.pending_prompt_id = prompt.message_id

    try:
        await query.answer()
    except Exception:
        pass

    asyncio.create_task(_delete_later(context, user_id, prompt.message_id, 30))


async def _delete_later(context, chat_id, msg_id, seconds):
    await asyncio.sleep(seconds)
    try:
        await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=chat_id, message_id=msg_id)
    except Exception:
        pass


async def handle_finalize(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.message or query.message.chat.type != "private":
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    update_status = context.bot_data.get("update_game_status")
    user_id = query.from_user.id
    display_name = query.from_user.full_name or query.from_user.first_name or str(user_id)

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        try:
            await query.answer("راند تموم شده!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    state.lock()
    game = await service.get_game(state.game_id)
    game_id = state.game_id
    dm_state.clear(user_id)

    if state.keyboard_message_id:
        try:
            await context.bot.edit_message_text(
                chat_id=user_id,
                message_id=state.keyboard_message_id,
                text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(state.letter, 0, 0, 60),
                reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard(state.answers, True),
                parse_mode="HTML",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        await query.answer("قفل شد! 🔒")
    except Exception:
        pass

    await context.bot.send_message(chat_id=user_id, text=msg.dm_locked())

    if update_status and game:
        try:
            await update_status(game_id)
        except Exception:
            pass


async def handle_noop(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if query:
        try:
            await query.answer("جوابات قفل شده! 🔒", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass


async def handle_dm_text(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    update_status = context.bot_data.get("update_game_status")

    if not update.message or not update.effective_user:
        return

    user_id = update.effective_user.id
    text = update.message.text
    if not text:
        return
    text = text.strip()
    user_msg_id = update.message.message_id

    state = dm_state.get(user_id)
    if not state:
        return

    async with dm_state.get_lock(user_id):
        state = dm_state.get(user_id)
        if not state:
            return

        if state.locked:
            try:
                await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=user_id, message_id=user_msg_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        if not state.pending_category:
            try:
                await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=user_id, message_id=user_msg_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        category = state.pending_category
        state.pending_category = None

        prompt_id = getattr(state, 'pending_prompt_id', None)
        if prompt_id:
            try:
                await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=user_id, message_id=prompt_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            await context.bot.delete_message(chat_id=user_id, message_id=user_msg_id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            answer = await service.submit_answer(
                state.game_id, user_id, category, text,
            )
        except ValueError:
            return

        state.answers[category] = text.strip()

        game = await service.get_game(state.game_id)
        remaining = _calc_remaining(context)
        if state.keyboard_message_id:
            try:
                await context.bot.edit_message_text(
                    chat_id=user_id,
                    message_id=state.keyboard_message_id,
                    text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(
                        state.letter, state.answered_count,
                        state.total_categories, remaining,
                    ),
                    reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard(
                        state.answers, state.locked,
                    ),
                    parse_mode="HTML",
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to edit keyboard: {e}")

        confirm = await context.bot.send_message(
            chat_id=user_id,
            text=msg.dm_answer_saved(category, text, answer.is_valid),
        )
        asyncio.create_task(_delete_later(context, user_id, confirm.message_id, 3))

        if update_status:
            try:
                await update_status(state.game_id)
            except Exception:
                pass


def _calc_remaining(context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE) -> int:
    import time
    from src.config import ROUND_DURATION
    start_t = context.bot_data.get("round_starts", {})
    for gid, t in start_t.items():
        if t > 0:
            elapsed = int(time.time() - t)
            return max(0, ROUND_DURATION - elapsed)
    return ROUND_DURATION

import html as html_mod
import asyncio
from telegram import Update
from telegram.ext import ContextTypes
from loguru import logger
from src.config import CATEGORIES
from src.interface.telegram import messages as msg
from src.interface.telegram import keyboards


async def handle_game_trigger(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    if not update.effective_chat or not update.effective_user or not update.message:
        return

    text = update.message.text
    if not text:
        return
    text = text.strip()

    triggers = ["بازی", "شروع بازی", "بازی اسم و فامیل", "اسم و فامیل"]
    if text not in triggers:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    group_id = update.effective_chat.id
    user = update.effective_user

    existing = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if existing:
        await update.message.reply_text(msg.error("یه بازی فعال هست."))
        return

    game = await service.create_game(group_id, user.id)
    name = user.full_name or user.first_name or str(user.id)
    await service.join_game(game.game_id, user.id, user.username or "", name)

    game = await service.get_game(game.game_id)
    players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}

    await update.message.reply_text(
        msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
        reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
        parse_mode="HTML",
    )


async def join_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        try:
            await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    name = user.full_name or user.first_name or str(user.id)
    try:
        game = await service.join_game(game.game_id, user.id, user.username or "", name)
    except ValueError as e:
        try:
            await query.answer(str(e), show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    dm_ok = True
    try:
        await context.bot.send_message(
            chat_id=user.id,
            text="✅ ثبت‌نام شد! منتظر شروع بازی باش.",
        )
    except Exception:
        dm_ok = False

    players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}
    try:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
            reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
            parse_mode="HTML",
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        if dm_ok:
            await query.answer(f"خوش اومدی {name}! ✨")
        else:
            await query.answer(
                f"{name}، لطفاً اول ربات رو توی پیوی استارت کن!", show_alert=True,
            )
    except Exception:
        pass


async def start_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        try:
            await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    if user.id != game.host_id:
        try:
            await query.answer("فقط میزبان!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    try:
        game = await service.start_game(game.game_id, user.id)
    except ValueError as e:
        try:
            await query.answer(str(e), show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    game2, rnd = await service.begin_round(game.game_id)

    context.bot_data.setdefault("game_messages", {})[game.game_id] = query.message.message_id

    try:
        await query.edit_message_text(
            msg.game_started(rnd.letter, 1, game2.total_rounds),
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        await context.bot.pin_chat_message(
            chat_id=group_id, message_id=query.message.message_id,
            disable_notification=True,
        )
        context.bot_data.setdefault("pinned_messages", {})[game.game_id] = query.message.message_id
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to pin: {e}")

    start_cd = context.bot_data.get("start_countdown")
    if start_cd:
        start_cd(game.game_id)

    dm_failed = []
    for pid in game2.players:
        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        try:
            kb_msg = await context.bot.send_message(
                chat_id=pid,
                text=msg.dm_keyboard_text(rnd.letter, 0, len(CATEGORIES), 60),
                reply_markup=keyboards.category_keyboard({}, False),
                parse_mode="HTML",
            )
            dm_state.start(pid, game.game_id, rnd.letter)
            state = dm_state.get(pid)
            if state:
                state.keyboard_message_id = kb_msg.message_id
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"DM failed for {pid}: {e}")
            dm_failed.append((pid, game2.players[pid].display_name))

    if dm_failed:
        names = "، ".join(
            f'<a href="tg://user?id={uid}">{html_mod.escape(n)}</a>'
            for uid, n in dm_failed
        )
        try:
            await context.bot.send_message(
                chat_id=group_id,
                text=f"⚠️ {names} پیوی بات رو باز نکردن!",
                parse_mode="HTML",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        await query.answer("بازی شروع شد! 🎮")
    except Exception:
        pass


async def leave_command(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    if not update.effective_chat or not update.effective_user or not update.message:
        return

    text = update.message.text
    if not text or text.strip() != "/leave":
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    group_id = update.effective_chat.id
    user_id = update.effective_user.id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game or game.state.value != "lobby":
        return

    if user_id == game.host_id:
        await update.message.reply_text(msg.error("میزبان نمی‌تونه خارج بشه."))
        return

    try:
        await service.leave_game(game.game_id, user_id)
    except ValueError:
        return

    game = await service.get_game(game.game_id)
    if game:
        players_dict = {uid: p.display_name for uid, p in game.players.items()}
        await update.message.reply_text(
            msg.lobby(game.player_count, players_dict),
            reply_markup=keyboards.lobby_keyboard(),
            parse_mode="HTML",
        )


async def cancel_game_callback(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    query = update.callback_query
    if not query or not query.from_user or not query.message:
        return

    service = context.bot_data["service"]
    dm_state = context.bot_data["dm_state"]
    user = query.from_user
    group_id = query.message.chat_id

    game = await service.get_game_by_group(group_id)
    if not game:
        try:
            await query.answer("بازی پیدا نشد!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    if user.id != game.host_id:
        try:
            await query.answer("فقط میزبان می‌تونه لغو کنه!", show_alert=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return

    cancel_cd = context.bot_data.get("cancel_countdown")
    if cancel_cd:
        cancel_cd(game.game_id)

    pinned = context.bot_data.get("pinned_messages", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)
    if pinned:
        try:
            await context.bot.unpin_chat_message(
                chat_id=group_id, message_id=pinned,
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    dm_state.clear_for_game(game.game_id)
    await service.cleanup(game.game_id)
    context.bot_data.get("game_messages", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)
    context.bot_data.get("round_starts", {}).pop(game.game_id, None)

    try:
        await query.edit_message_text("🚫 بازی لغو شد.")
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        await query.answer("بازی لغو شد!")
    except Exception:
        pass
